title: Tech Note: Full Data Export and Import
author: Timothy A Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: DOM Create XML Ref (project definition XML)

historical_commentary.text: The classic EXPORT DATA/IMPORT DATA per-table wrapper pattern shown here remains valid and still works in current 4D versions, though it operates at the classic table/field level rather than through ORDA entities, which is the more common data-access layer developers reach for first today for most day-to-day data manipulation (export/import for full backup or migration purposes is a more specialized, still-legitimate use of this classic API).
related_updates: EXPORT DATA/IMPORT DATA are unchanged, still-supported classic 4D language commands with no ORDA equivalent for this specific bulk full-database use case

For record-level data manipulation generally, ORDA entities/entity selections are now the default modern approach, but this note's use case — full-database export/import via a generic per-table wrapper — remains a specialized, still-useful classic-API technique
